# GoFurry Lite

> A static archive and discovery directory for furry websites, communities, creative projects, and games.

GoFurry Lite continues the original GoFurry directory using a historical catalogue snapshot dated 2026-11-15. Listings provide historical context and links to original sources. Lite does not monitor live website availability or provide live game prices.

## Home

- [English home](https://go-furry.com/): The default directory.
- [Simplified Chinese home](https://go-furry.com/zh): The Chinese directory.

## Website categories

- [Communities](https://go-furry.com/categories/community)
- [Art & Galleries](https://go-furry.com/categories/gallery)
- [Literature](https://go-furry.com/categories/literature)
- [Tools & Resources](https://go-furry.com/categories/resources)
- [Commissions & Marketplace](https://go-furry.com/categories/marketplace)
- [News & Knowledge](https://go-furry.com/categories/knowledge)
- [Games & Interactive](https://go-furry.com/categories/gaming)
- [Events & Organizations](https://go-furry.com/categories/events)

## Games and archives

- [Furry Games Directory](https://go-furry.com/games): Game profiles, tags, and store links.
- [Furry Game Collections](https://go-furry.com/games/collections): Selections by theme or gameplay.
- [Original website groups](https://go-furry.com/site-groups): Groups preserved from the legacy directory.
- [Release notes archive](https://go-furry.com/updates): Public updates from the original site.
